product.name: Release Rail
product.oneSentence: Let a person and an agent inspect and operate the same ordered release sequence.
audience: Maintainers coordinating finite release work with an agent
product.sharedArtifact: A four-step sample release rail with explicit pending, current, and complete states.

humanWorkflow.entrypoint: Open the rail, inspect the current step, then advance or reopen a named step.
humanWorkflow.visibleFeedback: The path, current step, completion count, revision, and activity record update from the canonical rail store.

capabilities.userJourney: Inspect every step and the current durable release position.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Read the ordered path and state summary.

resultContract.summary: Return the rail, ordered steps, current step, completion count, and revision.

successEvidence: The returned path and revision match the visible rail.

capabilities.userJourney: Complete the current step and move the durable path to the next step.

ui.visibleEffect: The current node completes and the next pending node becomes current.

resultContract.summary: Return the completed step, next current step when present, completion count, and committed revision.

successEvidence: The completed and next-current nodes match the returned result.
The visible revision matches the returned revision.

capabilities.userJourney: Reopen a completed step and return later steps to pending so the route remains truthful.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Activate Reopen beside a completed step.
ui.visibleEffect: The named step becomes current and every later step becomes pending.

resultContract.summary: Return the reopened step, affected later steps, completion count, and committed revision.

successEvidence: The reopened step is visibly current.
Later steps are visibly pending at the returned revision.
